Do you want to work in a company that develops systems to help keep people and society safe?

We are looking for an experienced Bid Manager to lead and manage the full bid lifecycle for complex defense and security solutions, ensuring the submission of high-quality, compliant, and competitive proposals that align with Saab's strategic objectives.

Your Role

As a Bid Manager, you will own the end-to-end bid lifecycle, serving as the strategic lead from initial qualification through to contract award. You will be responsible for orchestrating cross-functional teams to deliver high-impact proposals that align our technical capabilities with our customers' most critical needs.

• Strategic Leadership: Formulate and execute winning bid strategies in close collaboration with Sales, Engineering, Legal, and Finance.

• Analysis & Compliance: Conduct deep-dive analyses of RFPs and ITTs to ensure all customer requirements are fully understood and meticulously met.

• Proposal Development: Craft compelling, technically accurate proposals that maintain high standards of clarity, consistency, and professionalism.

• Project Governance: Manage bid budgets and timelines, proactively mitigating risks to ensure on-time, high-quality submissions.

• Stakeholder Coordination: Facilitate internal and external review cycles, integrating diverse feedback into a cohesive final document.

• Commercial Negotiation: Provide expert input on proposal content and commercial terms during customer negotiations.

• Market Intelligence: Leverage trends, competitor activity, and customer insights to sharpen our competitive edge.

• Process Innovation: Drive the continuous improvement of our bid management tools and internal methodologies.

Your Profile

We are seeking a strategic professional who combines technical acumen with commercial savvy. You have a proven track record of securing high-value contracts within complex technology sectors and the leadership skills to guide multidisciplinary teams under pressure.

• Education: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field (Master’s degree preferred).

• Experience: 3-5 years of bid, proposal, or project management experience within the defense, aerospace, or complex technology sectors.

• Proven Success: A demonstrated history of leading and winning complex, high-value bids.

• Regulatory Knowledge: A strong grasp of government procurement processes and contractual frameworks.

• Communication: Exceptional English verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex technical concepts.

• Leadership: Strong ability to motivate, coordinate, and lead cross-functional teams.

• Operational Excellence: Superior organizational skills and an acute attention to detail.

• Technical Skills: Proficiency in MS Office Suite and dedicated bid management software.

• Mobility: Ability to travel domestically and internationally as required.

What can you expect from us?

Saab Danmark is a company that is growing and are in a transition phase to develop more product focused deliveries. This gives you a great opportunity to take part in shaping the future system designs and deliveries to a demanding customer segment. You can expect:

• A key leadership role in a technically advanced defense environment.

• The opportunity to influence the safety and supportability of products and systems across their complete lifecycle.

• A skilled and committed multidisciplinary team.

• Professional development and opportunities to grow within the organization.

• Focus on our teams, good collaboration and giving our employees the ability to take ownership of their tasks.

Candidates must be able to obtain a security clearance by the Danish Defence Intelligence Service. This entails that candidates, as a minimum, have had residency within NATO/EU for the last 7 years.

About Saab Danmark A/S

Saab in Denmark is part of the Saab Group with headquarters in Stockholm, Sweden. At the same time, Saab Danmark is an independent legal company with a flat organisational structure. Our main business area is delivering integrated communication solutions to military markets in Denmark and abroad.

You can find further information about our integrated communication solution TactiCall, at www.saab.com/naval.

VP of Financial Data Products

**Reports to SVP Data and AI | Financial Insights and Commercial Intelligence

**Location: Copenhagen

We are looking for a data engineering and analytics leader with strong data product management experience and a passion for financial and commercial intelligence. You will lead data engineers, analysts, and machine learning data scientists to deliver trusted data products for Finance and its stakeholders, including executives.

Core mandate and collaboration

Own the full data product lifecycle, from source integration and modelling to analytics, delivery, adoption, and reliability. Provide accurate, timely data, forecasting tools, and accessible AI-driven insights for ARR forecasting, budgeting, reporting, and commercial analysis. Proactively partner with and support internal customers, including Finance and executives, on how to use data and AI products to identify efficiency gains, automate workflows, and create measurable business value.

Partner with Finance and business owners to agree requirements, priorities, and acceptance criteria, and jointly ensure data correctness. Finance and business owners retain ownership of financial definitions, business assumptions, budgets, and final sign-off; you own technical implementation, data quality, and product operations.

Your responsibilities

• Own the Finance data product roadmap from discovery to production support. Prioritise initiatives by measurable business value, including efficiency and automation, and communicate dependencies and trade-offs.

• Lead engineers, analysts, and data scientists as one team, providing practical technical guidance on pipelines, data models, analytics, and dashboard design.

• Integrate source systems and deliver tested, documented datasets, dashboards, and analytical tools using agreed business definitions and rules.

• Develop forecasting and scenario tools with Finance and data scientists, ensuring model validation, transparent assumptions, and clear communication of uncertainty. Finance approves business assumptions and official outputs.

• Partner across Finance, Commercial, Technology, and Data and AI to resolve data issues, agree ownership and service expectations, and drive adoption.

• Identify opportunities beyond stated requirements and advise stakeholders on data products that improve efficiency, automate workflows, and help teams and the Group steer business priorities.

• Deliver AI and agentic intelligence products that connect insights to action, with appropriate validation, controls, and human oversight.

• Stay at the forefront of data and AI technology, adopting advances that provide better tools, faster insights, and a simpler path from analysis to execution.

Your experience

• 7+ years working in data-intensive roles across data engineering, analytics or data product development, with deep exposure to how production pipelines and data models are built and run.

• Proven delivery of financial or commercial data products from strategy and business case through implementation, adoption, and measurable business impact, supported by strong product management and team leadership.

• Strong practical analytics experience and statistical and machine learning expertise to guide data scientists and critically assess model validation.

• Understanding of financial and SaaS metrics, including ARR, revenue, billing, churn, retention, and profitability, with a strong interest in enabling financial planning and commercial decisions through reliable data products.

• Exceptional stakeholder management and influencing skills: build trusted internal relationships, align stakeholders without direct authority, advise proactively, challenge constructively, and resolve competing needs.

• Ability to prioritise opportunities by value creation, link technical delivery to business outcomes, and translate emerging technologies into useful stakeholder tools.

**Preferred Experience

**

• Experience in a private-equity-backed, SaaS, hosting, subscription, or multi-brand business.

• Experience standardising financial reporting and forecasting across brands, countries, or acquired businesses.

• Experience implementing AI-enabled financial products or tools with measurable improvements in adoption, accessibility, or decision-making.

• The drive for delivering AI and agentic intelligence products into production, including implementation, evaluation, adoption, and measurable outcomes.

**ORDERYOYO – Senior Data & AI Platform Engineer

**Remote

• Quarterly team gatherings in one of our global offices

Join OrderYOYO’s Data team to build the data pipelines and lakehouse that power executive reporting and merchant insights across our platform, and automate how we deliver finance data and AI-driven data products to the rest of the business.

You’ll own complex changes from technical design through release and production operation, working closely with the leadership team, Finance, Product and fellow engineers. Your work will improve the accuracy and reliability of our reporting, merchant insights and finance data, while reducing routine manual Finance work.

Our data platform runs in a Microsoft Azure cloud environment, and we’re moving it to Microsoft Fabric. We value transferable experience: strong Azure Databricks or Synapse engineers who can quickly develop deep Fabric expertise are encouraged to apply. This is a hands-on engineering role, not a pure architecture, BI or people-management position, and you’ll regularly design, code, troubleshoot and operate production data solutions.

**Role Mission

**Build and evolve OrderYOYO’s data platform into a single source of truth for executive reporting, merchant insights, finance automation and AI, leading the move to a modern Microsoft Fabric lakehouse. You’ll help strengthen the reliability and quality of our data in production while building AI into how we deliver data products and supporting our growing international restaurant platform.

**Core Responsibilities

**

• Design, build and operate production-grade data solutions in Microsoft Fabric across Lakehouse, Warehouse, notebooks, pipelines and related platform capabilities.

• Build and run production pipelines in Fabric, Python and PySpark that are tested and maintainable, not just notebooks.

• Design ingestion and transformation patterns that scale across multiple source systems, databases and business domains while controlling source impact, concurrency and platform cost.

• Manage Fabric capacity and cost, and retire redundant legacy layers.

• Lead migrations from legacy to modern platforms with metric parity, stakeholder sign-off, change control and safe decommissioning.

• Run the platform in production: monitoring, alerting, incident triage, root-cause analysis, data-quality checks, lineage and runbooks.

• Diagnose and resolve production issues across SQL, Spark, pipelines and semantic models, including performance degradation, data failures and capacity/resource constraints.

• Support and evolve governed semantic models and reusable metric definitions, working closely with analytics and business stakeholders to ensure performance, consistency and reliability.

• Build AI into the platform and our delivery: RAG, Azure OpenAI and agents, with prompt and version management.

• Deliver applied data science such as churn, recommendations, personalisation, fraud or risk models, and show the results.

• Work with executives, Finance, Product and engineering, and judge when to move fast, standardise, automate or hold.

**Must-have Requirements

**

• 8+ years of relevant data experience, including substantial recent hands-on data engineering or data-platform engineering responsibility in production environments.

• Demonstrated ability to independently take a data-engineering problem from requirements and technical design through implementation, production deployment, monitoring and ongoing operation.

• Deep hands-on Microsoft Fabric, or strong Synapse, Databricks or Delta experience with a clear path to Fabric.

• Strong understanding of lakehouse architecture and Delta-based data engineering, including partitioning, schema evolution, file optimisation and performance considerations.

• Expert SQL and T-SQL, including complex modelling and tuning.

• Production-grade Python or PySpark.

• Strong experience designing and implementing incremental data ingestion patterns, including approaches such as CDC, change tracking or watermarks, with reliable merge/upsert, replay and idempotent processing.

• Experience with analytical and semantic data modelling, ideally with Power BI/Fabric semantic models, including performance optimisation, governance and reusable business metrics.

• Working knowledge of Azure platform fundamentals including Azure SQL, ADLS/OneLake, Entra ID, managed identities, RBAC and Key Vault.

• A track record of leading a legacy-to-modern migration.

• Real, hands-on AI engineering beyond out-of-the-box Copilot.

• Concrete data science or ML models you delivered, with results.

**Strong-to-have Experience

**

• Strong Power BI/Fabric experience, including Direct Lake, DAX, semantic model performance tuning, incremental refresh and capacity considerations.

• Infrastructure-as-Code experience with Terraform, Bicep or equivalent tooling.

• Data platform experience in SaaS, marketplace, fintech, payments, e-commerce or multi-region businesses.

**Who We Are

**At OrderYOYO, company culture comes first. We create a positive, inclusive environment where people are trusted to do their best work and take ownership of what they build. We look for engineers who take ownership, raise risks early, explain decisions clearly, collaborate respectfully and follow through on commitments.

Our values describe what that looks like day to day:

• Passion: Adaptable and positive in a fast-moving environment, proactive about improving how things work.

• Action: Leads by example and takes the initiative rather than waiting to be asked.

• Compassion: Supports colleagues and considers the impact of decisions on merchants and teammates.

• One Team: Communicates clearly in writing and in person, stays calm under pressure and shares information openly.

We help restaurants succeed online by providing branded websites, mobile apps and tailored marketing solutions, giving them full control of their business. By removing high commission fees charged by third-party platforms, we empower restaurants to grow sustainably.

**What We Offer

**

• A salary of up to £75,000 per year (or local equivalent).

• A remote role, with quarterly in-person gatherings at one of our global offices.

• Ownership of a business-critical data and AI platform.

• A collaborative, international engineering team.

Join Copenhagen Energy Trading as our next Quantitative Researcher - Algorithmic Trading (Short-term Power Markets)

Copenhagen Energy Trading (CET) shapes the future of the energy transition by combining deep market expertise with technical excellence in data, quantitative research and engineering to drive, automate and optimise our trading operations.

We’re a small, elite team based in central Copenhagen specializing in power trading and asset management across Europe and North America. Technology is core to how we operate, powered by exceptional talent and one of Europe’s most advanced automated and analytical trading environments for power markets. But we're not done. We want to push automation and advanced analytics even further, and to do that we need more exceptional people.

The Opportunity

That’s where you come in. We’re looking for an outstanding Quantitative Researcher with a proven track record of building real-time algorithmic trading strategies that operate with high reliability in regulated industries. You'll play a key role in developing strategies for the European short-term power markets.

This isn't a narrow coding or analyst role. You'll have an end-to-end mandate, from prototyping and data engineering to strategy implementation, backtesting and low-latency execution in our algorithmic trading framework. You'll own your projects from idea to P&L, working autonomously alongside a close-knit group of software engineers, quantitative researchers and expert traders.

So, if you feel energized by the intersection of markets, advanced analytics and trading technology and you want to help build something that moves power to where it’s needed the most, then we must talk.

Responsibilities

• Research and model the markets: Analyse energy market dynamics and turn your insights into predictive models that drive profitable trading strategies.

• Own the data: Build and maintain high-quality datasets that combine fundamental and real-time market data.

• Take strategies to production and keep them running: Own the path from research to live trading, shaping the systems, forecasting tools and data pipelines that run our strategies in real time. Once they're live, you'll monitor their performance, handle issues as they come up and make sure they trade reliably day to day.

• Shape the team's direction: Work closely with engineers, quantitative researchers and traders to challenge ideas, share expertise and influence where we take our algorithmic trading next.

• Master the domain: Become a domain expert and understand algorithmic trading architectures and order execution logic in the short-term power markets.

Who are you?

You have:

• Quantitative expertise: A track record of building accurate forecasting models and trading strategies for financial or energy markets, with a rigorous approach to research and validation.

• Software and data skills: Advanced Python skills, and the ability to write clean, efficient, reliable code, backed by solid computer science fundamentals (data structures, algorithms, system design). Strong data skills, from sourcing and cleaning to structuring complex datasets. Some experience with C++ would be a plus.

• Ownership: The ability to work independently and deliver in a fast-paced environment.

• Strong communication: Excellent problem-solving and communication skills with full professional proficiency in English.

• Domain knowledge: A genuine interest in learning about power markets and systems. If you already have that domain knowledge, then that is a big plus.

• Education: An advanced degree in a quantitative field such as Mathematics, Physics, Computer Science or Engineering.

What We Offer

• Growth environment: Be part of a young, ambitious, and expanding tech-driven trading company where talented people are given responsibility and room to grow.

• Exceptional team: Work closely with experienced quantitative researchers, software engineers and power traders.

• Competitive compensation and flexibility: Receive a competitive salary package with benefits and enjoy flexible work arrangements that support your work-life balance.

• Strong culture: Participate in both social and professional events, including team sports, company parties, teambuilding and informal gatherings that strengthen our team spirit.

• Central Copenhagen location: Work from our office in Carlsberg Byen, located in beautifully renovated historic Carlsberg buildings.

About Copenhagen Energy Trading

Copenhagen Energy Trading A/S was founded in 2021 and is part of Copenhagen Energy Group.

We specialize in short-term power trading across Europe and North America. Through technology, data, and market expertise, we develop discretionary and algorithmic trading strategies that help move power to where it is needed most.

Based in Copenhagen, we are building a collaborative, high-performance environment where talented people are trusted with responsibility and given the freedom to make an impact.

How to apply

If this opportunity feels like the right fit for you, we would love to hear from you.

Please apply via LinkedIn and submit your cover letter, CV, and university transcripts as a single PDF. Please note that applications that do not meet these requirements may not be considered.

If you have any questions, please contact Jens Christian Johannsen at jc@copenhagen-energy.com or Anna Schumann at as@copenhagen-energy.com.

_**About Monta

**Monta powers the EV charging ecosystem. With 300,000+ monthly users and millions of charge sessions every month, our platform accelerates the electrification of mobility.

This is a fast-moving place. The problems are hard, the pace is quick, and the bar is high. If you like real ownership, figuring things out, and seeing the direct impact of your work, you’ll do well with us.

AI is built into how we work. It helps us ship faster, make better decisions, and stay lean. Everyone at Monta is expected to use AI tools thoughtfully — and to find smart ways to use them to move the work forward.

Our principles keep us grounded: Build Together & Finish, Sweat the Details, Customer First, and Aim for the Moon.

The best part of Monta is the people — sharp, ambitious, and good to be around. You’ll be challenged, supported, and trusted to deliver.

The Role

We're looking for an Engineer to join our Financial Services team, the team responsible for every euro that flows through Monta's platform. This is a hands-on individual contributor role where you'll own delivery of meaningful pieces of our financial systems and grow your expertise in the domain, helping us scale reliably as we expand across Europe.

Financial Services is at an inflection point. Our transaction volume is growing fast and already processes millions of euros each month. We're building the next generation of our financial infrastructure, including new billing models and compliance capabilities to support expansion into new EU markets. The problems are hard, the stakes are real, and the work matters.

We need someone who takes ownership of what they build. You'll own medium-sized projects from design through to production, working independently within your team and delivering quality outcomes.

You should also be someone who has embraced AI as a core part of how you work. We use Claude Code extensively across the Financial Services team for everything from writing and reviewing code to designing systems and exploring financial domain problems. We expect you to be an advanced AI user who actively finds new ways to leverage these tools to move faster and think better.

**This Is What You Will Achieve

**

• Help rebuild Monta's financial backbone. You'll contribute to the new invoicing system that every customer will use, owning meaningful slices of the new infrastructure.

• Power EU expansion. You'll build features within our compliance infrastructure (e-invoicing, fiscalization, VAT) that enables Monta to enter new European markets.

• Strengthen the money flow. You'll improve the reliability and scalability of payment processing, reconciliation, and withdrawal systems across a rapidly growing transaction volume.

**What You’ll Do

**

• Deliver core parts of the new invoice system. Build features within the new invoicing architecture that supports multiple billing models and financial flows, owning your slice end-to-end and contributing to design discussions.

• Build and scale compliance infrastructure. E-invoicing across European markets. Fiscalization integrations. A VAT engine that handles the complexity of cross-border EV charging.

• Improve payment flows from card to payout. Card payments, automated reconciliation, withdrawal reliability, and working capital management.

• Collaborate across Finance, Legal, Revenue Operations, and Product to deliver new billing and commercial models. You won't work in a silo.

• Build for systems that must be right. Every euro must be traceable from summary down to line item. You'll write code with auditability, correctness, and scale in mind, and contribute to design discussions for new components.

• Grow with the team. Contribute through code reviews, design discussions, and knowledge sharing, and help onboard new joiners as you grow into the domain.

What We’re Looking For

• Solid backend engineering experience. You've built and shipped production systems and you write clean, maintainable code. Java/Kotlin preferred, but strong engineers from other stacks are welcome.

• Some exposure to financial systems is a plus. Billing, invoicing, payment processing, or similar domains where correctness matters — but we'll help you grow the depth.

• A sense of ownership. You take responsibility for what you ship, follow it through to production, and flag issues early rather than waiting to be asked.

• Comfortable asking questions and learning fast. Regulatory and financial domains have a lot of nuance — you bring curiosity and a willingness to dig in.

• Curiosity about financial infrastructure. Invoicing, VAT, compliance, payment flows. You don't need to be a domain expert on day one, but you're eager to go deep.

• Advanced AI adoption. You already use AI tools daily in your engineering workflow and you're always looking for new ways to apply them. You don't just accept suggestions, you prompt deliberately, iterate on output, and integrate AI into how you design, build, and debug.

• Strong collaboration and communication skills. This role sits at the intersection of engineering, finance, legal, and product. You build alignment fast and communicate clearly with non-technical stakeholders.

**Bonus

**

• Experience with EU financial regulations, e-invoicing standards, or fiscalization

• Experience with payment service providers or payment infrastructure

• Familiarity with event-driven architectures (Kafka) or high-throughput data processing

**If the mission excites you but your experience isn't a perfect 1:1 match, apply anyway. We care about potential, not perfection.

**AI at Monta Engineering

AI is central to how we build software at Monta. It's not a side experiment. It's embedded in our daily work and we expect every engineer to be a power user.

**Tools We Use Daily

**

• Claude Code for writing, reviewing, and refactoring code, exploring domain problems, and building internal tooling

• Claude / Gemini for research, design thinking, and documentation

• Notion AI for docs, knowledge management, and meeting notes

• AI-enhanced testing and monitoring

We expect you to bring a strong opinion on how to use AI effectively in engineering. If you've built custom workflows, pushed the limits of agentic coding, or found creative ways to use LLMs in your development process, you'll fit right in.

Why Monta

• Impact, not easy mode — your work matters, and you’ll feel it every day.

• Ownership from day one — we don’t micromanage, we expect you to deliver.

• The people are extraordinary — talented, driven, and fun to work with. You’ll be challenged, supported, and inspired in equal measure

**What We Offer

**

• A yearly education budget and extra days off to use it.

• A friendly and social company culture with movie nights, Friday bars, pub crawls, and more.

• Free lunch every day.

• Pension & health coverage to keep you secure for today and tomorrow.

• Paid parental leave to support life’s big moments.

• Warrants program - be part of our growth story.

• Flexible working hours; as long as you’re at key meetings and delivering great work, we trust you to manage your schedule.

**Please send us your application in English.

**To succeed in this position, your spoken and written English skills need to be proficient. Since Monta is a globally active company, you’ll be communicating often and regularly with our co-workers and partners around the world, making your professional English knowledge essential.

Please note that we don’t accept unsolicited applications from headhunters or recruitment agencies. Unsolicited applications sent to our company or co-workers are considered to be the property of Monta, and we won’t agree to pay any referral compensation or recruiter fee without a signed agreement.

Find out more by visiting https://monta.com/uk/careers/

Svitzer offers an exciting opportunity to contribute to how we strengthen our commercial capabilities across a global organisation. We have ambitious growth plans, which you will support as the Commercial Excellence Partner.

If you would like to see our tugboats in action and learn more, visit our website and watch this short video: Svitzer Introduces TRAnsverse Tug.

You will become part of an ambitious global organisation where commercial drive and accountability go hand in hand with collaboration across cultures. You will be encouraged to take ownership and have the opportunity to help shape the role in our fairly new team. We offer flexible ways of working and room to develop.

**Responsibilities

• Support the development and continuous improvement of commercial processes, tools and methodologies that enable consistent and effective commercial execution.

• Facilitate knowledge-sharing and exchange of commercial best practices across regions.

**Who We Are Looking For

You enjoy collaborating with colleagues across functions, regions and cultures and are comfortable working on several initiatives and stakeholder relationships at the same time. You combine analytical thinking with a practical mindset and enjoy turning ideas and insights into solutions that can be used in the business.

**Shape the Future of Dairy

If you are looking to shape the future with an ambitious global cooperative that truly cares about your growth, where everyone feels valued and empowered, and collaboration is the core of culture, Arla is a choice you can feel good about.

**At spektr, we are on a mission to automate the world’s most complex compliance workflows through AI. Founded by the team behind HelloFlow (acquired by Trulioo), spektr is building the infrastructure and AI agents to run compliance at scale.

Compliance, built like product.

Financial services has changed enormously. Much of the technology behind compliance hasn’t. Teams still spend hours on manual checks, disconnected systems slow down launches, and entering a new market can mean rebuilding the same processes all over again.

We’re changing that. spektr gives regulated businesses one platform for onboarding, monitoring and investigations, with configurable workflows and AI agents that do the legwork. Product, Operations and Compliance can move together, with the control they need to grow.

It’s a huge opportunity in an industry that has moved slowly for too long. We’ve built a product we’re proud to put in front of the most demanding customers. Now we’re looking for people who want to help get it into their hands.

$26M raised, including a $20M Series A led by NEA, with backing from Northzone, Seedcamp and PreSeed Ventures.

Customers worth getting excited about. We work with businesses including Pleo, Trustly, Nexi and Santander. These are large accounts with complex problems, ambitious teams and plenty of room for us to make a difference.

Three offices: Copenhagen, London and Iași, with customers across more than 15 countries.

**THE OPPORTUNITY

**We’re hiring a Product Owner to build products that compliance teams at banks and payment companies rely on every day, in more than 15 countries. You’ll work across the core of the spektr platform, from onboarding and monitoring to investigations, where our AI agents are taking on work that used to take analysts hours.

You will shape what compliance looks like when AI agents do most of the work. You’ll prototype, put ideas in front of compliance teams early, and work with engineering and design to ship what holds up in a regulated environment. You’ll do it at a Series A startup that moves fast, with the autonomy to take an idea from a blank page to a product running at banks and payment companies.

**What You Will Be Doing

**

• Explore several ways to solve a problem before committing to one, and come back with a clear view on which gives users the best experience, and why.

• Shape the product experience with our designers. Make complex compliance workflows simple to use, so analysts spend their time on decisions, not on the tool.

• Push how far AI can go in compliance. Our customers are regulated institutions, so every automated decision has to be explainable and defensible. You’ll work out what our AI agents can take on, what a human still needs to review, and what it takes for a compliance team to trust the result, then move that line further with each release.

• Turn customer requests into platform capabilities. When a customer asks for something specific, find the version that solves their problem and fits into the existing platform, so it stays configurable and works for the next customer too.

• Work hand in hand with engineering in Copenhagen and Iași. Align on what we’re building and why, agree how it fits the platform’s direction, and make the calls that keep work moving.

• Learn from the field. Work with our implementation team, who sit on site with customers and see every rough edge first, and use what they and our production data show you to decide what to improve.

**What We Are Looking For

**

• You’ve owned product on a B2B platform and can show us what you built, how you tested it with users and what changed as a result. Experience in financial services, fintech or another regulated industry is a plus.

• You build with AI. AI tools are part of how you prototype, research and explore ideas every day, and you have a view on how AI is changing the way products get made.

• Hands-on and fast. You’d rather show a working prototype than describe one, and you’re comfortable putting early work in front of users to learn quickly.

• Strong product and UX instincts. You can take a complex workflow and make it feel simple, and explain why one design works better than another.

• A platform thinker. When a customer asks for something, you look for the solution that fits the existing platform and scales beyond that one customer.

• Technical enough to go deep with engineers. You understand how systems, data and APIs fit together, and engineers want you in the room when decisions get made.

• Opinionated and open. You have a clear view on how things should work, argue for it, and change your mind when users or evidence show you otherwise.

• Close to customers by instinct. You’d rather sit in on a call with a bank’s onboarding team than read a summary of it.

Your route into product might have been through engineering, design, data, solutions architecture or operations. We’re interested in what you’ve built, how you think, and how quickly you learn. Prior compliance experience is a plus but isn’t a requirement.

**OUR PROCESS

**

• Intro call with our Talent team (30 minutes)

• Technical Interview (30 minutes)

• Technical Interview (60 minutes)

**How To Apply

**We hire the smartest, kindest, and most unrelenting people and let them do their best work. You’ll be joining a team with a proven track record and the "Product-Market Fit" to change an entire industry.

jobs.occupation: PhD Scholarship in Nonlinear Nanophotonics: Trapping Light for Extreme Light–Matter Interactions - DTU Electro
jobs.description:
Are you an experimental physicist eager to push light–matter interaction to its extremes? 

We offer a PhD scholarship at DTU Electro, where you will trap light in nanoscale optical cavities coupled to highly nonlinear 2D materials, and control them to let light interact with light far more strongly than conventional devices allow.

To trap and release light on demand, we use photonic crystal cavities in thin-film lithium niobate (TFLN), whose strong electro-optic effect allows fast electrical control. Our team has recently demonstrated ultracompact TFLN cavities used as modulators [1], with electrically controllable coupling to waveguides [2], and as multiport switches [3]. The project builds on these results and shares fabrication efforts with our collaborators at Harvard University, who pioneered the TFLN platform [4].

Photons interact only through a material nonlinearity, and in conventional static cavities the interaction time is fundamentally bounded, which dynamically coupled cavities can overcome [5]. You will combine such cavities with atomically thin 2D semiconductors with exceptionally strong nonlinearities to explore a largely uncharted dynamic regime of nonlinear optics, aiming to generate quantum states of light, such as squeezed light, at ultralow energies. The project is part of the Center for Nanophotonics (NanoPhoton), a Center of Excellence funded by the Danish National Research Foundation.

Responsibilities and qualifications
You will drive the experimental work in the project from device design to demonstration, working closely with PhD students, postdocs, and senior researchers at DTU and our collaborators at Harvard University. Depending on your interests, you will have the opportunity to:

• Design photonic crystal cavities and circuits using electromagnetic and multiphysics simulations.
• Fabricate devices in DTU Nanolab’s state-of-the-art cleanroom.
• Integrate 2D materials with photonic chips.
• Characterize devices using high-speed electro-optic, pulsed-laser, and quantum-optical measurements.
• Compare your experiments with theoretical models of cavity dynamics.
• Present your results at international conferences and in leading journals.
You are curious and driven, enjoy hands-on laboratory work, and take ownership of the progress and quality of your work.

Required qualifications:

• A strong background in optics or photonics.
• Experimental experience in optics or photonics, e.g., from your master’s project.
• Programming experience in Python.
You must have a two-year master's degree (120 ECTS points) or a similar degree with an academic level equivalent to a two-year master's degree.

Desired qualifications:

• Nanofabrication or integrated photonics.
• Nonlinear or quantum optics, or 2D materials.
Approval and Enrolment 
The scholarship for the PhD degree is subject to academic approval, and the candidate will be enrolled in one of the general degree programmes at DTU. For information about our enrolment requirements and the general planning of the PhD study programme, please see DTU's rules for the PhD education. 

Assessment
Assessment of the candidates will be carried out by Associate Professor Mikkel Heuck and Professor Jesper Mørk.

We offer
DTU is a leading technical university globally recognized for the excellence of its research, education, innovation and scientific advice. We offer a rewarding and challenging job in an international environment. We strive for academic excellence in an environment characterized by collegial respect and academic freedom tempered by responsibility.

Salary and appointment terms
The appointment will be based on the collective agreement with the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations. Please see DTU’s salary structure for scientific staff: www.inside.dtu.dk/en/human-resources/during-employment/salary/salary-structures.

The period of employment is 3 years.

You can read more about career paths at DTU here.

Further information 
Further information may be obtained from Associate Professor Mikkel Heuck (mheu@dtu.dk).

You can read more about our department at www.electro.dtu.dk.

If you are applying from abroad, you may find useful information on working in Denmark and at DTU at DTU – Moving to Denmark. Furthermore, you have the option of joining our monthly free seminar “PhD relocation to Denmark and startup “Zoom” seminar” for all questions regarding the practical matters of moving to Denmark and working as a PhD at DTU. 

Application procedure 
Your complete online application must be submitted no later than 8 December 2026 (23:59 Danish time).

Applications must be submitted as one PDF file containing all materials to be given consideration. To apply, please open the link "Apply now", fill out the online application form, and attach all your materials in English in one PDF file. The file must include:

• A letter motivating the application (cover letter)
• Curriculum vitae 
• Grade transcripts and BSc/MSc diploma (in English) including official description of grading scale
You may apply prior to obtaining your master's degree but cannot begin before having received it. 

Applications received after the deadline will not be considered.

All interested candidates irrespective of age, gender, disability, race, religion or ethnic background are encouraged to apply. As DTU works with research in critical technology, which is subject to special rules for security and export control, open-source background checks may be conducted on qualified candidates for the position.

You will join a research team at DTU Electro that is part of NanoPhoton, an interdisciplinary center that brings together several DTU departments. NanoPhoton is a highly collaborative and international community of PhD students, postdocs, senior researchers and professors, where theorists and experimentalists work side by side. We value curiosity, openness and helping each other. Questions are always welcome, and experienced colleagues will help you get started in the laboratory and cleanroom.

DTU Electro 
DTU Electro employs more than 300 skilled researchers with competencies in electrical and photonics engineering. As a department, we strive towards creating sustainable energy and a greener internet, as well as strengthening cyber security and health technology. Working with industry and public organizations is one of our top priorities to find and implement new solutions to our society. We aim to offer education, research, and innovation of the highest standard, and our focus on application-oriented research enables us to work across many engineering disciplines and research areas, such as IT and the medical and health sciences. We have a close collaboration with researchers from all over the world, just as we collaborate with industry and public authorities about the dissemination of solutions based on electrical and photonics engineering as their key enabling technologies. 

DTU – For the benefit of society since 1829
DTU is one of Europe's leading elite technical universities. Through research and education at an international top level, we create solutions to the major societal challenges of our time and help secure Europe's global leadership in sustainable technological development. Since Hans Christian Ørsted founded DTU almost 200 years ago, our mission has remained the same: We develop and create value through the natural and technical sciences for the benefit of society. DTU has 13,800 students, 1,600 PhD students, and 6,500 employees. We work in an international environment and have an inclusive, stimulating, and informal work culture. DTU has campuses in all parts of Denmark and in Greenland and collaborates with the best universities around the world.

[2] M. Rasmussen et al., Optica Quantum 2.0, QM4B.4 (2025).
[3] A. Buzzi et al., arXiv:2610.31757 (2026).
[4] D. Zhu et al., Adv. Opt. Photon. 13, 242 (2021).
